name: Security
description: They open the campus before the first class and close it long after the last light goes out.

name: Cleaning & Housekeeping
tagline: People who make the campus ready before we arrive.
description: Every corridor, classroom and hostel wing is theirs before it is anyone else's.

name: Maintenance & Repair
tagline: People we notice mostly when something breaks.
description: Wires, water, and worn out hinges, they keep the campus quietly working.

name: Canteen
description: From the first breakfast to the last order at night, someone here is always keeping the campus fed.
